About me

Trusted counsel.
Real results.

Attorney Cathrine Ruvarashe Mazhindu is a highly accomplished legal practitioner based in Harare, Zimbabwe. A graduate of the Catholic University of Zimbabwe, she brings exceptional analytical rigour, strategic thinking, and a client-first philosophy to every matter she handles.

With deep expertise spanning corporate transactions, family disputes, civil litigation, and property law — she has built a reputation for diligence, discretion, and delivering outcomes that truly matter to her clients. Attorney Ruvah doesn't just practise law; she becomes a trusted partner in your corner.

How I work

My process

01 Initial Consultation We meet to understand your situation, goals, and legal exposure. Fully confidential — no obligation. Free · 1 hour
02 Case Assessment Thorough analysis of the facts, applicable law, and the strongest strategy for your specific circumstances. 1–3 days
03 Strategy & Action Drafting, negotiation, court filings, or transactional work — executed with precision and transparent communication at every step. Matter-specific
04 Resolution & Follow-up Whether settled, adjudicated, or completed — I ensure you understand every outcome and your rights going forward. Ongoing support

Questions

Common questions

My core practice areas are Family Law, Corporate Law, Civil Litigation, Residential and Commercial Conveyancing, Insurance Law, and Legal Drafting (including Wills and Estate Planning). If you're unsure whether I can help, contact me and we can discuss your matter.
Absolutely. Everything discussed during our initial consultation is fully protected by attorney-client privilege. I offer a free first consultation so you can share your situation openly before making any commitment.
I offer transparent, itemised billing. Depending on the nature of your matter, I may work on a fixed-fee, hourly, or retainer basis. All fees are discussed and agreed upon upfront — no hidden charges, ever.
It depends greatly on the type of matter. A straightforward property transfer may take 4–6 weeks; a contested divorce or civil litigation can take several months. I always give you a realistic timeline during our initial assessment.
Yes. While I am based in Harare, I am able to assist clients across Zimbabwe and can also provide remote consultations for clients who are not located locally. Reach out to discuss your specific situation.
